references.text: The description of the veil (parochet) that separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy in the tabernacle, the same veil mentioned in Num 4:5.
Instructions for building the ark of the covenant (aron ha'edut), which the priests were to cover when the camp broke up.
Moses is instructed to place the ark of the covenant in the tabernacle and shield it with the veil.
Moses brings the ark into the tabernacle and hangs up the veil to shield the ark of the covenant.
The Lord's ark of the covenant went ahead of the people when they broke camp, following the procedures described in chapter 4.
Hebrews describes the furnishings of the tabernacle, including the veil and the ark of the covenant that were covered by the priests.
